record.question: A 70 year old woman undergoes Mini Mental Status Examination and scores 20 out of 30. How should the nurse interpret the score?
record.explanation: Official final key: C — Moderate cognitive impairment. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 14, printed Q57. Source limitation: The score-to-severity classification depends on the scale/cutoff system; 20/30 lies in a range labeled mild or moderate in different references. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
